mapper.sql: id, user_id, item_type, dish_id, combo_id, quantity, selected, customization_json, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_type = #{itemType} AND (dish_id = #{dishId} OR (dish_id IS NULL AND #{dishId} IS NULL)) AND (combo_id = #{comboId} OR (combo_id IS NULL AND #{comboId} IS NULL)) AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM shopping_cart WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND selected = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart (id, user_id, item_type, dish_id, combo_id, quantity, selected, customization_json, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{itemType}, #{dishId}, #{comboId}, #{quantity}, #{selected}, #{customizationJson}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE shopping_cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE shopping_cart SET selected = #{selected}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE shopping_cart SET customization_json = #{customizationJson}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE shopping_cart SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE shopping_cart SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND selected = 1 AND deleted = 0
